title: Bounded Site mutation validation reads
opportunity: Create and update Site mutations acquired the distributed mutation lock but still used the request token directly for the PostgreSQL snapshot read used by validation.
rootCause: A slow validation snapshot could hold a mutation request after lock acquisition without a bounded read response, and the browser had no localized recovery copy for that distinct timeout.
implementation: Added a two-second linked SiteMutationReadBudget with explicit client-cancellation distinction.
Applied the budget to POST /api/sites and PUT /api/sites/{id} snapshot reads while keeping writes, activation and lock acquisition on the request token.
Returned site_mutation_read_timeout and added bounded Thai recovery copy to the Multi-Site browser error mapper.

tdd.red: SiteMutationValidationReadBudgetTests failed before implementation because both mutation endpoint regions lacked the budget contract.

verification.impeccableDetector: 0 anti-patterns; four pre-existing advisory design-system-color findings in app.js (#ff4d5e, #22374f, #ff6378); no new finding

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL slow-read execution, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive verification, full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified.
